title: [BUG] Reset time formatting issue
body:
i live in Germany and the "reset time" looks a bit weird for me: 

```Your limit will reset at 9 Uhrpm (Europe/Berlin).```

the "correct" way for Germany would actually be: 

```Your limit will reset at 21 Uhr (Europe/Berlin).```

Sorry for that mostly irrelevant nitpicking 😅
author: mneuhaus
